snippet.title: Sonic R: 100% Playthrough (Definitive Experience)
snippet.description:
Sonic R: 100% Playthrough (Definitive Experience)

This video showcases a 100% full game playthrough of Sonic R for PC. In this video I showcase all characters, Chaos Emeralds, & S Coins. Using the Sonic R Updater allows players to experience the PC version of Sonic R in a much more definitive way, including things such as higher resolutions, texture and UI fixes, and much more. These mods allow the game to be ran on modern hardware PCs by patching it. The Mod Loader also allows players to download mods and fixes for a definitive experience.

18:58 - Metal Knuckles Boss Race - Character Unlock

23:17 - Dr. Eggman Boss Race - Character Unlock

28:14 - Radiant Emerald w/ Sonic
31:07 - Tails Gameplay

35:08 - Amy Gameplay

38:51 - Metal Sonic Gameplay
40:22 - Tails Doll Gameplay
42:34 - Metal Knuckles Gameplay
44:21 - Egg Robo Gameplay
46:21 - Credits
49:48 - Outro
